brand.name: One Kings Lane
brand.description: A design-led home destination combining curated furnishings, editorial inspiration, vintage character, and expert design help.
brand.proposition: Products, expertise, and inspiration that help people live their own style.
brand.voiceSummary: Warm expertise with an editorial eye: specific, confident, helpful, and never aloof.

provenance.method: Live desktop and mobile surface audit, computed-style sampling, official-site content review, official asset capture, public social-channel review, and public advertising-library review.
notes: Permanent brand evidence is separated from current campaign content.
Current offers, inventory, prices, and campaign copy are external runtime data and are not encoded as brand constants.
Social and advertising observations are dated snapshots; channel cadence, performance, targeting, and spend are not inferred from public creative.
Private advertising-account data was not available and is not represented as audited evidence.
The package is output-neutral; provider and rendering adapters belong outside this directory.
